description: This file defines the Address model class within the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Account namespace. It includes methods for managing customer addresses such as add, edit, delete, get, and list addresses, along with related metadata retrieval functions.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Represents the customer address management functionality, including CRUD operations and retrieval of address details.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Inserts a new address record for a customer and optionally sets it as default, ensuring only one default address per customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing customer address with new data, and manages default address status.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Deletes an address belonging to a customer, optionally by address ID.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific customer address, including associated country and zone data.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Fetches all addresses associated with a customer, returning an array of address details.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total count of addresses for a specific customer.
